title: Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II — Corpus
description: Research corpus of freeflow and values probes with explicit deployment provenance. The 1.2.64 release candidate adds 245 revision-pinned Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 BF16 Colab/vLLM traces. No new DOI is claimed. Summary: 71,587 valid samples, 624 probe cells, 212 model labels; deployment labels are not unique-weight identities.
